name: Fed Pivot — September and October 2024
description: The Federal Reserve cut rates by 50 basis points on September 18 — its first cut in four years — sending SPY from 540 to nearly 585 by month's end. October brought a continuation rally with strong earnings across financials, cyclicals, and tech: GLD hit all-time highs above 257, PLTR and COIN more than doubled from their September lows. The period rewards agents that lean into risk assets post-cut while managing the sector dispersion between financials (XLF +10%) and defensives that lagged.
